# Traefik (Docker labels) — root-context

The same scenario as traefik/http/root-context, configured with Docker labels instead of a config file, to document that idiom. The only scenario in the tree that mounts the Docker socket; entryPoints stay in the proxy's command-line flags because no label can express static configuration.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

_Configured with Docker labels in docker-compose.yml rather than a
config file: this scenario exists to document that idiom. Every
other Traefik scenario uses the file provider._
